title: T07 — Raise a run-new-tests item when a pack is added or changed
goal: Detect new or changed cases (pack id, version and case hash) against a committed run ledger, and make CI and check:freshness raise them in the backlog
acceptance: A committed metadata-only ledger (no outputs, prompts or timings) records per case identity the last accepted run: report hash, model/profile identity and date
npm run check:gauntlet-runs lists cases with no ledger entry or a changed hash, and fails CI unless an open backlog item names them
A .harness.json impact row on vendor/gauntlet-protocol.json and evals/gauntlet/** tells the agent to raise or update that item in the same PR
A newer published Gauntlet release is reported at session start (as check:freshness does for the harness) and raises a pin-and-run item; NERV pulls, Gauntlet never pushes to or runs in its consumers
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
validation: Fixtures: a new pack, a changed case and an unchanged case give exactly the expected new/changed/current lists
escalation: The run itself is an owner-approved real-model campaign (AGENTS: separate triggers and budgets); this task only raises it

effort.basis: Owner request 2026-11-11: NERV always consumes every common Gauntlet pack plus its own, and a pack added or changed raises a run-new-tests item. Estimate, not a measurement.
